name: agents.list
description: List stable owner-bound pages of durable agent definitions. Optional active/archived filter precedes paging. Summaries omit instructions; records carry revisions. Does not launch sessions.

name: agents.get
description: Read an owned durable agent_id, encrypted instructions, template reference, permission mode, support configuration and revision. Does not read credentials or launch sessions.

name: agents.create
description: Create an encrypted durable agent definition, not a running session. Native template/support ownership rules apply. permission_mode defaults to the native yolo default; ask is explicit. Reuse request_id with identical arguments on retries. Returns public operation metadata and revision.

name: agents.update
description: Patch an owned durable definition using expected_revision from agents.get and stable request_id. Instructions/name/slug are encrypted; supports replaces the support configuration. Does not launch, move or stop existing sessions. An existing ask permission mode cannot be weakened to yolo; yolo may be tightened to ask.

name: agents.archive
description: Archive an owned durable definition while retaining historic references. Native archive does not stop existing sessions. Supply current revision and stable request_id; this is not permanent deletion.

name: bridges.list
description: List owner-bound pages of owned execution bridges with status, platform and enrollment/plan eligibility. No credentials, hostname, commands or diagnostic dumps.

name: providers.list
description: Discover provider profiles/effective models on an exact owned bridge_id; optional owned agent_id checks support. Profiles use limit/cursor; models use model_limit and each record models_next_cursor. Continue models with that provider_profile plus model_cursor; do not combine profile/model cursors. Eligibility is configuration availability, not a capacity reservation, and writes recheck it. No credentials, arguments or environment; no silent target fallback.

name: instances.list
description: List owned managed agent_instance_id records with explicit durable agent_id, bridge/provider/profile/model, status and task references. Filters precede stable owner-bound paging. No tokens, transcripts, environment or raw diagnostics.

name: instances.get
description: Read one owned managed agent_instance_id public status/configuration snapshot. Runtime identity is distinct from durable agent_id. No credentials, environment, command lines or diagnostics.

name: instances.create
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

name: instances.start
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

name: instances.stop
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

name: instances.reconfigure
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

retry_request_id.description: Original reconfigure request_id for explicit recovery retry with a new request_id. Destination must match.

name: instances.operations
description: Poll the durable operation selected by operation_tool and request_id; reads never resend commands.

name: artifacts.list
description: Owned native artifacts; list omits content, get opens bounded UTF-8 text/plain, text/markdown or application/json (maximum 64KiB plaintext,128KiB stored). That MCP inline window is a transport bound below the 15 MB (15,728,640-byte decoded) artifact content limit that HTTP uploads and ham-ctl enforce. For kind html-bundle, get returns content_base64: the complete stored ZIP archive (up to 15 MiB decoded) as canonical standard base64, byte-exact; decode it to the .zip file. Other unsupported or oversized content returns content_error with metadata. Update renames name/description only; content and associations are immutable. Delete permanently removes the native row; retries retain the receipt and artifact:// link. No filesystem paths, remote fetch, binary uploads, versions or rollback. expected_revision binds metadata; creation validates task/chain/project/agent associations.

name: artifacts.create
description: Owned native artifacts. Create either a text artifact (content + content_type text/plain, text/markdown or application/json, maximum 64KiB) or a static HTML bundle: entry (the start page, e.g. index.html) plus files; send exactly one of the two forms (content/content_type together with entry or files is rejected). files is an object mapping relative paths to {"text":"..."} for UTF-8 files or {"base64":"...","type":"image/png"} for binary files (standard padded base64, no whitespace; type optional and must match the extension). Bundle rules: relative '/'-separated paths without '..', '.', backslashes or leading '/'; allowed extensions html htm css js mjs json map txt md xml csv webmanifest png jpg jpeg gif webp avif bmp ico svg woff woff2 ttf otf eot; scripts are stored but never run by the viewer; at most 999 files and 15 MB (15,728,640 bytes) decoded in total. The Hub validates and packs the bundle, the approved device or hosted vault encrypts it, and every authorized device opens it in the artifact viewer. Rejections return invalid_bundle: <reason>. get opens bounded text only (64KiB plaintext,128KiB stored); other content returns content_error with metadata. Update renames name/description only; content and associations are immutable. Delete permanently removes the native row; retries retain the receipt and artifact:// link. No filesystem paths, remote fetch, versions or rollback. creation validates task/chain/project/agent associations.

entry.description: HTML bundle start page; must be a .html/.htm path in files.

files.description: HTML bundle members keyed by relative path.

additionalProperties.description: Exactly one of text or base64; optional type must match the extension.
